text.aria-label: Title text 'No arm beats the base B on CRPS at 24-120 h by more than seed noise; WL and RB are worse at one group Dot: estimate (seed 0 for the Stage 1 arms; seeds 0 and 1 for DL, ML, P1, and DT). text.tspan: No arm beats the base B on CRPS at 24-120 h by more than seed noise; WL and RB are worse at one group
